title: COMMUNICATION FROM THE PORT OF LOS ANGELES (POLA) and Appeal pursuant to California
text:
[Council File 26-1460-S1]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
COMMUNICATION FROM THE PORT OF LOS ANGELES (POLA) and Appeal pursuant to California
Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Section 21151(c) filed by Pacific Harbor Line, Inc. (PHL) of the action taken by the Board of Harbor Commissioners (BOHC) at its regular meeting held October 8, 2026, to find approval of the Port Rail Operating Agreement 26-10273 with Alameda Belt Line (ABL) exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to title 14 of the California Code of Regulations section 15061, subdivision (b)(3) (CEQA Guidelines) and the City of Los Angeles CEQA Guidelines Article II Section 2(f). Approval of the Agreement is also exempt from CEQA pursuant to CEQA Guidelines sections: 15301 - 15304.
Appellant: PHL, Inc.
Representative: Victor De La Cruz, Manatt, Phelps & Phillips, LLP
(Trade, Travel, and Tourism Committee report to be submitted in Council. If public hearing is not held in Committee, an opportunity for public comment will be provided.)
(Please visit lms.lacity.gov for background documents.)
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Pacific Harbor Line is appealing the Port's environmental (CEQA) exemption for the rail operating agreement with Alameda Belt Line.

locations.text: Port of Los Angeles, Los Angeles, CA
